summary: Executed backend+frontend testing for new transaction/payout filtering and payout payment_reference workflows on public URL. Backend search/reference contracts passed with new pytest coverage; frontend critical flows (search, date/category intersections, whole-order preservation, payout reference create/edit/search, responsive overflow) mostly passed.

integration_issues.flow: Payout filter reset via marketplace switcher (UI automation)
integration_issues.issue: Could not complete a deterministic automated click on mp-option-ALL in two runs from Payouts page; selector did not render/capture in that state, so this specific reset path remains unconfirmed by automation.

action_items: Main agent should manually self-test payout filter reset after source marketplace/store changes to confirm behavior in non-automation session.
If reproducible manually, harden top-bar marketplace dropdown interaction/state on Payouts route.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking backend contract defects found in /api/transactions/search or /api/payouts/{id}/reference.
Regex-literal search behavior, ownership scoping, date validation, and payout reference trimming/limits behaved as expected in API tests.
Frontend filter and payout-reference integrations are functionally healthy on tested paths; one marketplace-switcher reset path remains unconfirmed due UI automation interaction instability.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated TEST_FILTER_* stores and feature-specific transactions/payouts during pytest/UI checks; cleanup executed (fixture teardown + TEST_FILTER_UI_* cleanup test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature APIs are now covered by a dedicated 11-test suite: order literal search, whole-order preservation, same-child date/category intersection, blank order grouping, cross-store/marketplace/currency separation, group pagination, outcome pre-pagination, date validation, payout reference create/edit/clear/ownership, note+reference search, and payout pagination. Frontend validated: tx filters, debounced search behavior in practice, whole-order display under refund/date filter, Jan+Refund no-match, payout reference input/edit/search/note search, delete under active filter, and responsive overflow checks (390/768/1024/1440 no horizontal overflow). One UI automation path (payout marketplace-switch reset assertion) remained non-deterministic due dropdown option interaction.
rca of the issue: Potential UI automation-state mismatch on Payouts top marketplace dropdown: after setting payout search text and attempting source switch, mp-option-ALL was not consistently locatable in two runs. This may be an interaction timing/state issue (dropdown not opening/rendering) rather than a confirmed product defect; needs manual confirmation in browser.
